name: linear_create_issue
description: Create a new Linear issue (task). Requires `title` and `teamId` (get the team id from linear_list_teams). Optional `description` (markdown), `priority` (0 none, 1 urgent, 2 high, 3 medium, 4 low), `assigneeId`, and `projectId`. Returns { success, issue { id identifier title url } }.

teamId.description: Team id to create the issue in (from linear_list_teams).

priority.description: Optional priority: 0 none, 1 urgent, 2 high, 3 medium, 4 low.

projectId.description: Optional project id to file the issue under.

body_defaults.query: mutation CreateIssue($input: IssueCreateInput!) { issueCreate(input: $input) { success issue { id identifier title url } } }
